Question: Assalamualikum.My name is sarah.can i name my daughter ZARA.Pls reply me. Answer ID: 13362 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1248/980=H/1430) This name is not right, do not keep this name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
